description: Creates a new plan for a site, auto-creating the matching Polar product. protected_paths scopes access to this plan specifically — see set_config's description for how to gate a mostly-shared freemium codebase without splitting it into two trees.

description.description: Optional plan description shown at checkout.

protected_paths.description: Glob paths this plan grants access to (e.g. ['/premium/**']). Omitted means no plan-specific paths beyond the site's own protectedPaths.

site_id.description: The site's id, from list_sites or create_site.

name: create_plan
title: Create plan
